results.title: Caught Between Lands
results.overview: An experimental documentary featuring international college students commenting on their experiences of cultural isolation in America.

results.title: Fallen Angels by Noël Coward
results.overview: Two upper-class wives, their husbands away for the day, share a few toasts to their pre-marital dalliances—with the same man, who just may be en route from France to visit. Old rivalries and past scandals bubble to the surface in this intoxicating romp from one of theatre’s comedy masters.

results.title: Is This Life?
results.overview: A group of young adults, Navigate love, identity, self-destruction while trying to survive their twenties in a world that constanlty makes them feel no enough.

results.title: Dances with Weights
results.overview: After a misunderstanding, a famous strength athletics trainer accidentally finds himself at the position of training an elite dance squad, creating a conflict of interests which only increases after his protege Sashko falls in love with Milana, one of the the dance squad's most talented members. Will the two sides use their strengths to work together or will this match made in Hell crash and burn?

results.title: Here Comes the Son
results.overview: An incompetent grifter tries to rob an elderly woman with dementia, but an unexpected mother-son relationship develops.

results.title: Miss Representation: Rise Up
results.overview: MISS REPRESENTATION: RISING dives deep into the cultural backlash against women’s mental health, agency, and political power with technology exacerbating sexism and misogyny towards women and girls.

results.title: The game of my life
results.overview: For 20 seconds, Raí gazes at the horizon before taking the free kick that would decide the 1992 Intercontinental Cup title between São Paulo and Barcelona. Blending manga, the PLACAR magazine archives, previously unseen VHS footage shot in Tokyo, and exclusive filming in Paris, the movie delves into Raí’s journey toward his world title victory in Japan—a portrait of the past, present, and future.

results.title: Nakee 3: The Cursed War
results.original_title: นาคี 3 ครุฑา นาคี
results.overview: As destiny turns lovers into enemies, duty tears them apart, but love remembers what kingdoms forget, the love can end even the oldest war.

results.title: Simon Says So
results.overview: An aspiring ventriloquist begins to crack under the pressure of his first performance.

results.title: Fake It Till You Break Shit
results.original_title: Fake It Till You Break Shit
results.overview: Jeanie, who is homeless, works from her car in a dubious network marketing job. When she is invited to her old school friends' bachelorette party, she senses an opportunity to sell them her products. But she has underestimated how much she wants to finally be part of the group again.

results.title: La Nuit des autres
results.overview: Ready to do anything to meet what is expected of her, a young teenager makes up a love story with her neighbor.

results.title: A Tale of Lost Times
results.overview: An ordinary school day turns into a fantastic adventure for Petya, Marusya, and Vasya when their idle time becomes the source of power for three old wizards. In pursuit of youth, the villains steal the students' time with a magical gadget, but in their haste, they themselves turn into children, and the children into helpless old men. To set things right, they must not only win the magical battle but also lift the spell before sunset, and most importantly, understand the value of every wasted minute.

results.title: Materia Prima
results.overview: Bolivia has the world's largest deposits of lithium, a metal that is essential for the energy transition. Without lithium, no electricity storage facility, no data centre, no electric car, no smartphone would work. The Europeans want the raw material to save their automotive industry. The Bolivians want it to combat poverty. While the Bolivian government negotiates with corporations from around the world, civil society groups are mobilising in rural areas, organised mainly by women. The film offers a rare insight into the Europeans' strategy to secure the sought-after material and carves out the conflicting interests towards extractivism and industrialisation in Bolivia.

results.title: SYNTHETICA
results.overview: Ada, a retired hacker living quietly as an art curator, discovers an illegal neural implant in their head after experiencing dangerous memory glitches. When an underground surgeon can't safely remove it, Ada is forced to accept one last job: infiltrate the corporation that created the device. As the mission unfolds, Ada must confront the truth about their forgotten past and the real purpose of the technology buried in their mind.

results.title: Winter Talk
results.overview: December 24. Hundreds of lorries are stranded at a port on the English Channel. Abbas, a veteran lorry driver, meets Pawel, a young Polish driver. Despite the language barrier, the two men are forced to spend Christmas Eve together.

results.title: Lingsir Wengi: Motel Malioboro
results.overview: To grow the DuniaHorror62 YouTube channel, Putik—who has the ability to see and communicate with spirits—joins forces with Ryan, Anggie, Aro, Dita, and their friends to visit an old motel in Malioboro. A forbidden room in the motel becomes their target for content, in hopes of making their channel go viral. Despite being warned, this group of young people recklessly enters the room anyway. Inside, they discover a tape recorder containing a recording of the song “Lingsir Wengi.” As soon as the song plays, eerie events and terror begin to haunt them. Putik realizes they’ve awakened a spirit—one that doesn’t just want to communicate, but has come bearing wrath and demanding vengeance be settled. This spirit reveals dark secrets and conflicts within their friendship. They must find a way to stop it before they lose their lives.

results.title: Led by the Ashes
results.overview: Two sisters, Bethânia and Laura, reunite to discuss a family matter. They travel the roads of the Pernambuco hinterland in search of their father's body, Seu Lauro. At home, Bethânia's daughter edits a video in which the living and the dead become intertwined in a game of silences and revelations. Ao Sabor das Cinzas (Led by the Ashes) is a magical realism piece about the collapse of communication and grief conveyed in real time.
Set in a medical college in a dread-stricken village, the film confronts the science behind superstitions, the superstitions in science, and an anomaly that neither can explain.
